# dbt-core 1.12 with dbt-duckdb, for the real-dbt tests in CI (#233; `real-dbt` job in
# .github/workflows/ci.yml). Every package is pinned, so a dbt or dependency release
# changes nothing in CI until this file does. To bump: in a Python 3.11 venv,
#   pip install dbt-core==1.12.<patch> dbt-duckdb==<version>
#   pip freeze
# then replace the pins below and run the job's tests locally with ODS_TEST_DBT set
# to that venv's bin/dbt.
